"""
    _get_grid_data(grid_file_path::String) -> Tuple{Vector{Point3f}, Point3{Int}}

Private function to load grid data from file.

# Arguments
- `grid_file_path::String`: Path to the grid file

# Returns
- Tuple containing:
  - xyz coordinates as Vector{Point3f}
  - n: grid dimensions as Point3{Int}
"""
function _get_grid_data(grid_file_path::String)
    h5open(grid_file_path, "r") do file
        coordinates = file["coordinates"]
        x = read(coordinates["x"])
        y = read(coordinates["y"])
        z = read(coordinates["z"])

        nx = read(file["metadata/dimensions/nx"])
        ny = read(file["metadata/dimensions/ny"])
        nz = read(file["metadata/dimensions/nz"])

        # Combine into Vector{Point3f}
        xyz = Point3f.(x, y, z)
        
        # Combine dimensions into Point3{Int}
        n = Point3{Int}(nx, ny, nz)

        return xyz, n
    end
end

"""
    read_eigenstate_info(file_path::String) -> Tuple{Vector{Point3f}, Vector{Point3f}, Float64, Float64, String}

Read eigenstate information from HDF5 file.

# Arguments
- `file_path::String`: Path to the eigenstate_info.h5 file

# Returns
- Tuple containing:
  - ki: wave numbers as Vector{Point3f}
  - ai: eigenvectors as Vector{Point3f}
  - ku: base flow wave number
  - U: base flow amplitude
  - flow_type: type of flow
"""
function read_eigenstate_info(file_path::String)
    h5open(file_path, "r") do file
        ki_matrix = read(file["ki"])
        ai_matrix = read(file["ai"])
        # Convert to Vector{Point3f}
        ki = [Point3f(ki_matrix[i, 1], ki_matrix[i, 2], ki_matrix[i, 3]) for i in 1:size(ki_matrix, 1)]
        ai = [Point3f(ai_matrix[i, 1], ai_matrix[i, 2], ai_matrix[i, 3]) for i in 1:size(ai_matrix, 1)]
        U = read(file["base_flow"]["U"])
        ku = read(file["base_flow"]["ku"])
        flow_type = read(file["flow_type"])
        
        return ki, ai, ku, U, flow_type
    end
end

"""
    read_amplitudes(file_path::String) -> Array{Float64, 2}

Read amplitude data from HDF5 file.

# Arguments
- `file_path::String`: Path to the amplitudes.h5 file

# Returns
- Amplitudes array
"""
function read_amplitudes(file_path::String)

    end
end

"""
    read_basis_function_registry(file_path::String, flow_type::String) -> Tuple{Dict, Dict, Dict}

Read basis function registry from HDF5 file.

# Arguments
- `file_path::String`: Path to the basis_function_registry.h5 file
- `flow_type::String`: Type of flow to read functions for

# Returns
- Tuple containing:
  - basis_functions: dictionary of basis function expressions
  - base_flow: dictionary of base flow expressions
  - variables: dictionary of symbolic variables
"""
function read_basis_function_registry(file_path::String, flow_type::String)
    h5open(file_path, "r") do file
        functions = read(file[flow_type])

        # Fetch the basis functions and the base flow
        basis_functions = functions["basis_function"]
        base_flow = functions["base_flow"]

        # Get the variables for the functions and set them in the
        # VelFieldCalc module's namespace and save for later use
        vars = functions["variables"]
        variables = Dict(var => Symbolics.variable(var) for var in vars)

        return basis_functions, base_flow, variables
    end
end
